title: Test report
description: Execution of the test plan's system cases on a deployed build. Valid only if the stand runs the head under test.

sha.description: The commit CI built and the stand was deployed from.

ci.description: CI on sha. If it is not green, stop: no deploy, no system cases.

failure.description: Failing job and the tail of its output, when not success.

build_version.description: What the stand reports about its running build, e.g. the health endpoint's version. Must contain the first 7 characters of sha. Empty if CI was not green.

results.description: One entry per system test case in the test plan. Empty if CI was not green.

actual.description: What the page showed, read from the DOM.

evidence.description: Screenshot path, plus a redacted EXPLAIN summary for the criterion's queries.

residue.description: Every record this round created on the stand.

blocked.description: Set only when the round could not run: no access, cannot seed, deploy infrastructure down. Stops the loop. CI failing on the code is not a blocker; it goes in ci.

results.evidence: .tmp/run/stand-1/TC-AC2-2.png; order-versions: backward index scan, 0.8 ms, 1.2M history rows
